# Aaron Peskowitz Real Estate

> Aaron Peskowitz is a licensed REALTOR® with eXp Realty specializing in residential real estate in Liverpool, NY and Central New York.

Aaron Peskowitz provides full-service home buyer and seller representation across Liverpool, NY, Syracuse, and Onondaga County.

- [Home](https://aaronpeskowitz.com/index.html): Overview of real estate services, featured portfolio, and consultation options.
- [Find Your Dream House](https://aaronpeskowitz.com/buy.html): Buyer representation services and home search tools.
- [Sell Your House](https://aaronpeskowitz.com/sell.html): Seller representation and home evaluation services.
- [About Aaron Peskowitz](https://aaronpeskowitz.com/about.html): Professional background and local market experience.
- [Client Testimonials](https://aaronpeskowitz.com/testimonials.html): Verified reviews from buyers and sellers.
- [Contact](https://aaronpeskowitz.com/contact.html): Office location, phone number, and direct inquiry form.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://aaronpeskowitz.com/faq.html): Real estate FAQs for New York buyers and sellers.
